title: A Probabilistic Digital Twin of UK En Route Airspace for Training and Evaluating AI Agents for Air Traffic Control
reasoning: The paper utilizes the 'Trustworthy and Ethical Assurance (TEA) framework' as a methodology for technical assurance and validation of the Digital Twin's accuracy. This is a safety-critical system assurance process rather than a benchmarking or evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics as subjects.
